description: Residence halls opened; most student arrivals occurred August 3-9
Two weeks of remote instruction announced
Undergraduate classes switched online; graduate and professional classes continued in person
Off-campus undergraduates restricted from campus except health services; on-campus undergraduates asked to remain on campus
Residence access restricted; indoor recreation closed; organizations remote; gatherings limited to 10; masking tightened
General surveillance phase began; source ST_Random label already exists earlier and cannot alone identify general screening rollout
Enhanced dashboard added seven-day average and test-category selectors; revision history remains incomplete
Letter planned inclusion of faculty in general surveillance the following day; not independent confirmation of execution
Day4 PCR and Day7 antigen tests permitted release after at least 7 days if negative; introduction date not established
10000 and 20000 course families resumed in person; deans could approve additional courses
Remaining in-person courses scheduled to restart subject to continued compliance
Saliva PCR surveillance added; exact start date not established by this report
Testing site moved to Joyce Center north dome; no exact effective date assigned
Sampler breakdown; raw file nevertheless contains RNA measurements on September 1 and September 9
Alternative extraction method failed quality assurance; data excluded by study authors
Game and field celebration reported; this event alone does not establish transmission effect
President reiterated exit testing and penalties; underlying exit-testing plan predated the game
End of fall semester including exams; do not treat all later testing dates as equal campus presence
